_lagprof_notes: Created with POST /api/alerting/rule/lagprof-stale-profiler. Keys starting with _lagprof are removed before sending.
Fires for each workflow (all-spaces, or each per-space copy) that ran in the last 7 days but has no completed run (success or no_data) in the last 3 hours.
A copy that never ran at all isn't detected; the Profiler health panel shows that.
Confirmed on 9.5.6: Kibana accepts this .es-query ES|QL params shape (esqlQuery, timeField, timeWindowSize/Unit, threshold [0] with ">").
name: Ingest Lag Profiler: no completed run in 3 hours

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM lagprof-runs
| EVAL workflow = COALESCE(lagprof.space.id, "all-spaces"),
       ok_recent = CASE(status IN ("success", "no_data") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 3 hours, 1, 0)
| STATS ok = SUM(ok_recent), last_run = MAX(@timestamp) BY workflow
| WHERE ok == 0
| LIMIT 100
